title: Goose (default)
description: Goose on your project with sandbox-ai's defaults and nothing more: only its maker's model is reachable, everything else is refused or asked; its telemetry is always off.

de.title: Goose (Standard)
de.description: Goose an Ihrem Projekt mit den Voreinstellungen von sandbox-ai und nichts weiter: nur das Modell seines Herstellers ist erreichbar, alles andere wird abgelehnt oder nachgefragt; seine Telemetrie ist immer aus.

notes: The model: Anthropic's API with your key (sandbox-ai secrets set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY once). Goose sees a placeholder, the connection proxy puts the key in on the wire, and Goose starts with its provider anthropic (its model: --model NAME, or goose configure in the sandbox). Another provider: --api-key api.openai.com=OPENAI_API_KEY or openrouter.ai=OPENROUTER_API_KEY, or a model server of yours with --llm (the preset goose-local-llm).
Nothing else is open: package registries, GitHub and every other host are refused or asked (--ask). For more: the preset coding-goose (PyPI, npm, GitHub) or sandbox-ai net allow during the run.
Its telemetry is always off and cannot be turned on.
Goose is not live-tested yet (a start says so); its image first: sandbox-ai build goose (a start builds it when it is missing).
